The Grand Emergence is the most secret ceremony of the [[Red Ajah]]. It is undergone in a warded place, spoken in a guarded way even so. In essence, it was a plan for seizing the [[White Tower]] should it prove necessary. Not all Red sisters are aware of the ceremony since it is shrouded in doublespeak and masked words. Supposedly, it has been practiced ever since the White Tower was founded.<ref name="comp">[[The Wheel of Time Companion]], Grand Emergence.</ref>
